clue.text: Herb, one originally cultivated next to a colonnaded hall

parts.note: basil is a kitchen herb
the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: what something was originally is how it began, so only the opening letter of the next word counts

parts.note: the first letter of cultivated
taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: A basilica was originally a Roman public building, an oblong hall with rows of columns; the word now also names large churches of that plan.

clue.text: Is it a jump ahead of others holding unfair trials?
